title: Electric Toothbrush Picks: TechRadar Tested Models
desc: TechRadar tested and recommended models. Each pick has a distinct award category; the numbered order follows the article and is not a universal head-to-head score.

source.name: TechRadar — Best electric toothbrushes (2026)
source.note: All listed products, source labels and selection context were checked against the linked source by AllRanks on 2026-10-21. The source presents distinct use-case awards, not a like-for-like composite score; the displayed order follows its numbered article sections.

items.name: Philips Sonicare 7100
items.detail: Best overall; customizable, quiet and feature-rich.

items.name: Suri Core 1.0
items.detail: Best value; simple design and long battery life.

items.name: Oral-B iO Series 10
items.detail: Best premium; smart feedback and thorough cleaning.

items.name: Dyson CameraJet Electric Toothbrush
items.detail: Best smart; camera-guided brushing and jet flossing.

items.name: Suri 2.0 Sustainable Electric Toothbrush
items.detail: Best eco-friendly; long battery life and plant-based brush heads.
